business_objective: Coordinate internal patient transfers and close each transfer record after destination readiness, escorted pickup, and receiving acknowledgement are recorded.

stakeholder_statements.text: A ward clerk creates an internal-transfer request and identifies the patient reference, originating ward, and destination ward.
The bed coordinator records whether the destination ward is ready to receive the patient.
The transport dispatcher assigns an escort porter to the transfer. The escort porter records patient pickup.
The receiving clerk records patient arrival and acknowledges receipt of the transfer documents.

The transfer records officer closes the transfer record only after destination readiness, patient pickup, and receiving acknowledgement are recorded. Providing clinical care and arranging ambulance transport are outside this project.

business_objective: Record pool-vehicle returns and close key-custody records after vehicle availability and returned-key status are documented.

stakeholder_statements.text: A driver creates a pool-vehicle return record and identifies the vehicle and reservation.
The driver records the return location.
The vehicle custodian records the returned key set as complete or incomplete and adds a note when it is incomplete.
The fleet desk clerk records whether the returned vehicle is available for another assignment.

The key records officer closes the key-custody record only after the vehicle return, key-set review, and availability outcome are recorded. Refueling the vehicle and performing maintenance are outside this project.

business_objective: Review corrections to recorded inventory-asset serial identities and update supported approved asset records.

stakeholder_statements.text: An inventory custodian submits an asset-identity correction and identifies the asset, recorded serial identifier, and proposed serial identifier.
The inventory evidence clerk records the evidence type and supporting evidence. The accepted evidence types have not been agreed.
The asset verification officer records the proposed serial identifier as matched or unmatched to the physical asset. The matching criteria are undecided.
The inventory supervisor records the correction as approved or returned and adds a reason when it is returned. The approval criteria are not finalized.

The asset register clerk replaces the recorded serial identifier only after a match and approval are recorded, then sends the outcome to the inventory custodian. The delivery channel is undecided. Physically relabeling the asset and disposing of the asset are outside this project.

business_objective: Review custody discrepancies for reusable shipping containers and update custody records after location and responsibility are confirmed.

stakeholder_statements.text: A route coordinator submits a reusable-container custody discrepancy and identifies the shipment, container type, and expected custodian.
The handover recorder records the last confirmed handover and its evidence type. The accepted evidence types have not been agreed.
The location verifier records the container location as confirmed or unconfirmed. The location-confirmation criteria are undecided.
The custody reviewer records a responsible custodian or marks the discrepancy unresolved. The responsibility criteria are not finalized.

The container records clerk updates the custody record only after a confirmed location and responsible custodian are recorded, then sends the outcome to the route coordinator. The delivery channel is undecided. Physically recovering containers and charging loss fees are outside this project.

business_objective: Review workspace data-region change requests while preserving an unresolved rule about whether archived data must move with active data.

stakeholder_statements.text: A workspace owner submits a data-region change review and identifies the workspace, current region, and requested region.
The data inventory reviewer records the active data categories and archived data categories included in the review. The categories that must be included have not been finalized.
The security reviewer records a security assessment. The reviewer says all workspace data, including archived data, must move to the requested region to avoid split custody.
The privacy reviewer records a privacy assessment and any restrictions. The reviewer says archived data must remain in the current region unless the workspace owner records member consent.

The migration governance officer records the review as approved or declined after the data inventory, security assessment, and privacy assessment are present. Nobody has decided which archived-data rule controls, who resolves the disagreement, what evidence proves member consent, or the maximum review time. Performing the data migration and changing subscription billing are outside this project; the meeting also wandered into complaints about the video-call echo.
